data_objects.name: dated_aft_pac_labels
data_objects.meaning: Application rows containing a binary 6PD/30-named label, one non-bank-organization count feature, and indexed AFT v4 and PAC v2 feature families.

variables.name: label_6pd_30
variables.meaning: Binary 0/1 outcome whose name references a 6PD/30 definition; the underlying event definition is not included.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: als_m1_id_nbank_orgnum
variables.meaning: Nullable numeric count-like feature for non-bank organizations associated with an identity in a one-month window, as indicated by the column name.

variables.name: aft_v4_f0 … aft_v4_f44
variables.meaning: Forty-five indexed AFT v4 numeric features; the family mixes score-like and larger count/day-like values and includes explicit values such as -1.

variables.name: pac_v2_x0 … pac_v2_x27
variables.meaning: Twenty-eight indexed PAC v2 numeric features on a score-like scale.

structure.description: Each row is an application-level labeled feature vector. No explicit row identifier or supplied train/test partition is present.

uncertainties: The 6PD/30 outcome definition and the semantics/calibration of indexed features are not documented.
Special numeric codes in the AFT family are not distinguished from valid values by separate missingness fields.
annotation_notes: Blank als_m1_id_nbank_orgnum cells are missing values.
Indexed AFT and PAC columns are grouped as regular high-dimensional families.
